annotations.title: Find the act that amended another

description: WHICH ACT DID THE AMENDING. An act whose only purpose is to amend another one is hidden from search on purpose (its text is already folded into the consolidated version), so 'care ordin a modificat anexa 6?' or 'ce lege a completat Legea 95/2006 în 2024?' found nothing. Give `law` — the amended act — to list every act that amended it, newest first, visible or hidden, each with whether it is still in force and how many changes it made; give `query` to search the hidden amending acts by title or subject. Each act is labelled — about the amended act, or one that changed it in passing (an omnibus act) — and says which provisions it changed. Works for a repealed act too: its history, headed by its repeal. Use lookup_article for the current text: it already contains the amendments.

dedicated_only.description: Optional, with `law`. true: only the acts that are ABOUT the amended act (its title names it, or most of what they did was to it); the omnibus acts that changed it in passing ("... și pentru modificarea altor acte normative") are left out. Every act is labelled either way.

query.description: Title/subject words of the amending act, e.g. 'Legii nr. 85/2014', 'reglementări contabile'.

name: search_amending_acts
